desc: Bazzalan's Horns: Bazzalan's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a red-skinned satyr): two long dark horns curving up and back, with long shaggy dark brown hair. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
Druid of the Fang Hood: a hood of green snake scales with a serpent's head on top, its fangs over the brow, from the Wailing Caverns
VanCleef's Mask: Edwin VanCleef's look: long straight black hair falling past the shoulders, and a red cloth mask tied over the nose and mouth (covering the tusks), the eyes uncovered
Archmage's Hat: a tall pointed purple archmage's hat with a silver band and pale stars, its tip flopping over, Archmage Arugal's
Twilight Cowl: a deep violet Twilight's Hammer cultist cowl, a glowing eye sigil above the brow
Bazil's Locks: Bazil Thredd's look: long straight black hair falling past the shoulders, and a red cloth mask pulled DOWN around the neck under the chin (the whole face uncovered)
Tinker's Goggle Cap: a leather tinker's cap with big brass goggles pushed up on top of it, gnome engineer style
Quilboar Bone Helm: a quilboar helm made from a boar's skull with tusks, ringed with bristly brown thorns, Charlga Razorflank's
Bloodmage Hood: a crimson Scarlet Crusade bloodmage hood with a fiery orange lining

Doan's Beard: Arcanist Doan's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a bald human arcanist): a short pointed ginger-red beard and moustache covering the chin and mouth (and the tusks); the eyes stay uncovered

Herod's Helm: Herod's look from World of Warcraft Classic (the Scarlet Champion): a red Scarlet Crusade helm with gold trim and two white swept-back wing horns at the sides, open-faced: the face stays fully visible
Inquisitor's Mitre: a tall white and gold bishop's mitre with a red Scarlet Crusade emblem, High Inquisitor Whitemane's
Amnennar's Mitre: Amnennar the Coldbringer's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a lich): a tall pointed purple-and-gold lich mitre. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
Archaedas's Hood: Archaedas's look from World of Warcraft Classic (an ancient stone keeper): a deep hood of carved grey stone. It sits on the head; the face stays fully visible in its opening
Sandfury Headdress: a jungle troll headdress of bright red, orange and yellow feathers with bone beads, Chief Ukorz Sandscalp's
Theradras's Crown: Princess Theradras's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a tall golden fan-shaped crown. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
Thane's Winged Helm: a dwarven steel helm with two white feathered wings at the sides, open-faced
Plague Hood: a dark green plague cultist's hood with sickly glowing green trim
Explorer's Pith Helmet: a sand-coloured explorer's pith helmet with a brown band, Explorers' League style
Dreamweaver Circlet: a circlet of green vines and leaves with a glowing emerald at the front, from the Emerald Dream

Thaurissan's Crown and Beard: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a Dark Iron dwarf): a squat white cap with a big red jewel on top, and a huge long braided black dwarf beard hanging down over the chest, covering the mouth and chin (and the tusks); the eyes stay uncovered
Omokk's Helm: Highlord Omokk's look from World of Warcraft Classic (an ogre chieftain): a dark red-and-black spiked ogre helm with a big pale horn on top, open-faced: the face stays fully visible

Drakkisath's Skull Crest: General Drakkisath's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a dragonkin general): a dragon skull headdress with long curved horns. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible

Alzzin's Horns: Alzzin the Wildshaper's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a teal-skinned satyr): two long curved golden-olive horns, with long shaggy golden hair. It sits on the head above the brow; the face stays fully visible
Highborne Diadem: a delicate silver Highborne elven diadem with a blue sapphire, Prince Tortheldrin's
Gordok Crown: the Gordok ogre king's crown, a crude heavy gold crown with big spikes, King Gordok's

Gandling's Headdress: Darkmaster Gandling's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a tall silver-and-gold horned headpiece, with a black cloth over the lower face (the mouth, chin and tusks); the eyes stay uncovered
Dreadlord Horns: a pair of large curved bone-white dreadlord horns, Balnazzar's
Rivendare's Helm: Baron Rivendare's dark death knight helm with horns and pale blue glowing trim, open-faced

Onyxia Hood: the hood of a cute homemade black dragon onesie costume, like a fan-made Onyxia costume: soft dark plush with stitched seams and a sewn-on patch, a row of red felt spikes over the top, two curved cream felt horns, big round button eyes on top, and a ring of stuffed cream felt teeth framing the face opening; the face itself fully visible through the opening. The hood ends at the jaw, like a hat: no neck, collar or shoulder part, so it goes with any clothes
Moonleaf Circlet: a silver circlet of moon-shaped leaves with a pale lavender moonstone, druid of the moon style
Wild King's Antlers: a pair of huge branching antlers with green leaves and moss growing on them
